neighbours.label: the limits of what can be known or perceived: God beyond understanding, none can fathom, the observable universe, light that cannot reach us; the same religious and cosmic topics without the limit stay low
fire: The prophet taught that the ways of the Almighty are past finding out.
Theologians admit that the nature of God is beyond human understanding.
No mortal mind can fathom the depth of divine wisdom.
Astronomers can only study the observable part of the cosmos.
Some galaxies are so remote that their light will never reach Earth.
The size of the whole universe may be forever unknowable to us.
Mystics say the divine essence is incomprehensible to the intellect.
Beyond the cosmic horizon lie regions we can never observe.
quiet: The prophet taught that the ways of the Almighty are full of mercy.
Theologians admit that the nature of God is a central topic of study.
Every believer can praise the depth of divine kindness.
Astronomers often study the bright part of the night sky.
Some galaxies are so bright that amateurs can photograph them.
The size of the solar system was measured with radar.
Mystics say the divine essence is present in daily prayer.
Near the city lie fields where farmers grow wheat.
